items.title: Bayesian occupancy filling-fraction with MES-ceiling-tension exceedance diagnostic
items.what_it_is: A clean statistical formalization of the production anchor F_Bayes: promote the occupancy Q(theta)=|x(theta)|/B (departure over the MES kinematic ceiling) to a posterior random variable, report F_Bayes=E[Q|D] (the unique squared-loss Bayes estimator, reducing to the algebraic F in the delta-posterior limit), plus the exceedance curve Pi(q*)=P(Q>q*|D) and especially the ceiling-tension diagnostic Pi(1)=P(Q>1|D). Proves Option A (P(x>0|D), a sign probability) is NOT a filling fraction, and that 'P(FLRW rejected|D)' is only definable via spike-and-slab and is then a monotone transform of the Bayes factor (adds nothing beyond ln B).

Lightweight to add to the existing nested-sampling output as a companion to the identified set.
items.non_overlap_note: ST-06 concerns the MIO joint-measure F and paired-depth G_F calibration (a different F); ST-04 builds identified sets under non-identification. The occupancy Q=|x|/B relative to the MES ceiling, the exceedance Pi(q*), and the ceiling-tension Pi(1) diagnostic are a distinct bound-occupancy reporting layer not present in the frozen ST set or PR-136/137.
items.decisive_falsifier: Pi(1) is ~0 for every realistic posterior (the posterior never approaches the MES ceiling), making the ceiling-tension diagnostic uninformative; OR it is shown to be a monotone function of ln B / already implied by the identified-set report (redundant).

items.title: Three-layer occupancy-posterior + exceedance-survival pushforward (x -> Q -> Pi) as the statistics-axis primary object
items.source_path: legacy_extract/bianchi-defect-framework-github/src/htt/infer/departure_posteriors.py (573L); orphaned current-repo copy at htt/htt/htt/core/departure_posteriors.py; theory in legacy_extract/bianchi-defect-framework-github/docs/R07_filling_fraction_bayesian_reformulation.md
items.what_it_is: A model-agnostic posterior pushforward engine that turns dynesty/NS draws into a normalized intra-model departure summary: Layer1 x (comparator-conditioned algebraic departure), Layer2 Q=x/x_max occupancy ratio with an honest status classifier (identified / super_ceiling / ill-defined-when-x<0), Layer3 Pi(q*)=sum_i w_i 1[Q_i>q*] the posterior exceedance (survival) function. Ships weighted-quantile and weighted-HPD helpers. R07 supplies the decision-theoretic backbone: F_Bayes = E[Q|D] is the unique Bayes estimator of the algebraic ratio under squared-error loss, and the exact area identity E[Q|D] = integral_0^1 Pi(q) dq connects the point summary to the full survival curve. This stack produces the CLAUDE.md production anchor F_Bayes=0.093 +/- 0.025.
items.why_dropped: The MIO re-scoping (PR-053 'MIO certified filling fraction', REV-R066) replaced the live surface object with htt/mio/formalism/filling_fraction.py, a certified algebraic contract whose metadata explicitly FORBIDS the terms posterior/evidence/likelihood/bayes-factor and carries no exceedance curve, no E[Q|D], no survival function. The Bayesian pushforward layer was quarantined in the orphaned htt/htt/htt/core tree (only egs3_prior_exposure.py touches it, and live obsstat carries no F_Bayes derivation at all).
items.rescue_value: Gives the 1/5 statistics axis a genuinely different PRIMARY object than model comparison or PPC: a normalized intra-model posterior summary with a decision-theoretic justification (Bayes estimator under squared-error loss), an exact area identity linking the scalar headline to the full survival curve Pi(q*), and built-in non-identification flags (super_ceiling / x<0 ill-defined). It is executable NOW on posterior draws the program already generates, and it is the machinery that actually produces the headline F_Bayes=0.093 anchor the live surface can no longer derive.
items.non_overlap_note: ST-06 / PR-142 handle the CERTIFIED MIO F/G_F measure's joint-measure invariance and matched-null calibration, treating F as a fixed scalar diagnostic. This item is the DISTRIBUTIONAL object p(Q|D) itself — the exceedance survival function and its first-moment (Bayes-estimator) identity — not an invariance/null check. PR-138/140 are SBC/replicated-PPC/model-comparison, none of which is intra-model occupancy. Not covered by any ST-01..08 or PR-119..166.
items.decisive_falsifier: On the program's actual dynesty draws, compute E[Q|D] two ways: (a) direct weighted posterior mean of Q, (b) numerical integral_0^1 Pi(q) dq of the tabulated exceedance. If they disagree beyond MC noise the area identity is wrong; and if P(x>0|D) already tracks 'amount of departure' monotonically (so the sign probability equals occupancy) the occupancy posterior adds nothing beyond a sign test -> LEAVE_DELETED.

items.title: F-perp-lnB obstruction theorem + area identity + sign-non-monotonicity of the departure coordinate
items.what_it_is: Three tight results that delineate what the occupancy posterior adds beyond model comparison. (1) Obstruction theorem: there is NO functional g with F = g(B_10) in general (proof by counterexample: two priors giving the same posterior/same F but different Occam penalty/different Bayes factor). (2) Area identity: F_Bayes = E[Q|D] = integral_0^1 Pi(q) dq (tail-expectation for Q in [0,1]). (3) Sign non-monotonicity: because x = Sigma^2 - W^2 + Omega_tilt + Omega_k has a MINUS sign on vorticity, P(x>0|D) is a sign probability, NOT an occupancy measure — so the naive 'FLRW-rejection probability' route collapses to a monotone transform of lnB and adds nothing.
items.why_dropped: Lived only as analysis docs (R07 open-problem session, DR-10 external derivation); never migrated into the code claim surface. When the filling fraction was reduced to the bare MIO certified contract, the theorem that justifies why it is not redundant with the Bayes factor (and not 'pseudo-Bayes') was left behind in the archive.
items.rescue_value: Directly rebuts the audit's N-STAT-PSEUDO-BAYES concern by proving the occupancy summary is a distinct, non-redundant statistical object rather than a repackaged evidence ratio. It is a self-contained, provable (dual-engine-verifiable) result that cleanly separates 'how much departure' (F_Bayes/occupancy) from 'which model' (lnB), giving the statistics axis a defensible theorem it can carry publicly without touching family-ID.
items.non_overlap_note: TH-02 / PR-127 is the graded/PSD-cone NON-IDENTIFICATION theorem (which departure directions are unreachable); this is a different, statistics-side obstruction (F cannot be a function of the Bayes factor) plus the area/first-moment identity. The existing egs3 'obstruction' modules concern Bianchi-V curl slaving and MES provenance, not the F-vs-evidence separation. Not present in any candidate or PR.
items.decisive_falsifier: Exhibit a single functional g and a prior family on the program's parameter space for which F = g(B_10) holds across all members (equal g-image whenever B_10 is equal); or show that on the real x = Sigma^2 - W^2 + ... posterior the sign of x IS monotone in departure magnitude. Either would collapse the obstruction/sign results and reduce F to a Bayes-factor reparameterization.
